title: BigBrain hippocampal subfields

space.name: BigBrain hippocampal subfields original surface coordinates
space.reference: Original self-contained GIfTI point arrays and triangle arrays in the BigBrain histological release. Embedded identity coordinate matrices are recorded.
space.correspondence: Surfaces within this package share the author release coordinate convention. Separate datasets retain their own source spaces and definitions.
space.unit_basis: The BigBrain histological release and associated source paper describe surface distances and morphometry in millimeters. Original coordinates are retained with metric scale 1.0; no shrinkage correction is added.

sources.title: BigBrain hippocampal subfields
sources.citation: DeKraker J, Lau JC, Ferko KM, Khan AR, Kohler S. Hippocampal subfields revealed through unfolding and unsupervised clustering of laminar and morphological features in 3D BigBrain. NeuroImage 206:116328 (2020). doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2019.116328. BigBrain foundation: Amunts K et al. Science 340:1472-1475 (2013), doi:10.1126/science.1235381. Original contributors: https://ftp.bigbrainproject.org/bigbrain-ftp/Credits.txt.

model_evidence: Original hippocampal surfaces from the histological BigBrain release, associated with the source study of unfolding and laminar/morphological subfield organization.
model_notes: Source-defined CA1, CA2, CA3, CA4, dentate gyrus and subiculum surfaces retain their exact supplied extent and bilateral identifiers.
The associated study combines histology, computational unfolding and feature analysis. Source labels and boundaries are interpreted within that method.
The independently retained NextBrain and Julich hippocampal definitions support comparison in their respective native spaces. Same-name regions do not establish interchangeable boundaries.
scope_notes: One source-designated normal adult postmortem specimen; source computational processing and reconstructed boundaries are retained.
Native source surfaces support spatial observation. Layer and subfield definitions remain specific to their source method.

teaching_sequences.title: Left hippocampal subfield relationships
teaching_sequences.instruction: Follow CA1, CA2, CA3, CA4, dentate gyrus and subiculum through the folded source geometry. Inspect each selected subfield with its immediate neighbors.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: Source-specific hippocampal definitions from histology, computational unfolding and laminar/morphological analysis.
teaching_sequences.step_prompt: Trace the selected supplied surface and describe its relationship to the other visible source components.
teaching_sequences.step_question: Which source component is selected, and how does its supplied extent relate to the visible neighboring surfaces?

teaching_sequences.title: Hippocampal folding and midsurface context
teaching_sequences.instruction: Inspect the original midsurface with CA1 as a reference on each side. Relate the sheet-like representation to the supplied folded subfield model.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: The midsurface is an author-derived geometric representation and preserves its own extent.
teaching_sequences.step_prompt: Trace the selected supplied surface and describe its relationship to the other visible source components.
teaching_sequences.step_question: Which source component is selected, and how does its supplied extent relate to the visible neighboring surfaces?

acquisition: Run neuroimage acquire bigbrain_hippocampus --data-root <data-root>. The common workflow downloads pinned self-contained GIfTI files directly, reuses completed files and retains original compressed sources.
